ns2:section.sectionText: Students will learn the fundamentals of ethical theory, corporate social responsibility, case competition formats, presentation skills and case analysis. In addition to weekly class meetings, students are expected to compete in at least one of several external case competitions throughout the semester. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
